notes.title: Closed Beta
notes.content:
We will start the Closed Beta of Project Horror Anthology: Project Prequel that will last for two weeks, and with it some news, check it out below:

 Support for Control.
 New alternate ending.
 New chests added.
 New animations.
 GIF updates.
 Trailer Update.
 Bug Fixes.

To get access to the Closed Beta, consider supporting us by clicking  here.

Remembering, bugs may occur during the beta, feel free to report them to us on our Discord if you encounter any.

Studio Vyrsar Games thanks you for your attention!
